item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Session-based authentication for Azure Blob and Data Lake Storage
item.description:
Session-based authentication is now in public preview for Azure Blob and Data Lake Storage. It is intended to reduce per-request authentication and authorization time for AI agents and applications while maintaining existing security controls.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Smart Tier (Azure Blob and Data Lake Storage) in Azure Government and China regions
item.description:
Smart tier for Azure Blob and Data Lake Storage is now generally available in Azure Government and China regions. It automates tier placement for standard online object storage, reducing the need for manual tier management.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Storage Actions adds automatic task updates, execution controls, and case-sensitive matching
item.description:
Azure Storage Actions now automatically propagates task definition updates, adds more execution control, and supports case-sensitive matching for automated data operations across Azure Blob and Data Lake Storage.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: ABFS Vectored Read for Azure Data Lake Storage
item.description:
ABFS Vectored Read is now generally available for Azure Data Lake Storage. It reduces request overhead for selective reads by batching nearby file ranges into fewer asynchronous storage requests.

  • Source: Azure Updates
